source: GameFAQs (section 'GameBoy Advance Pro Action Replay Save (North America)')
author: Fatalcraze
what_it_is: 386 hours of play time, mostly all pokemon. All legally caught. Jirachi, and Deoxys. Also All legendarys from Colosseum, and Fr/Lg. Lot's of good ev raised pokes. Almost every box is full. Have fun using this cool save.
